title: build save <id> --yes writes jitso/builds/<id>.yaml with status approved and every other byte of the draft, removes the draft, and the build is then listed and valid
source: intended: docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut" (build save asks on a terminal or takes --yes): a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK, which is a terminal answer or --yes; the guard denies the agent
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md "The v0.1.0 cut"). Without a terminal, `jitso build save <id>` refuses and writes nothing; with `--yes` it writes `jitso/builds/<id>.yaml`, which is the draft bytes with the `status` scalar `draft` replaced by `approved` and nothing else changed, removes `.jitso/drafts/<id>.yaml`, shows the file with `+ ` prefixes and prints `saved <id>: jitso/builds/<id>.yaml (status approved); the draft is removed`, exit 0. The saved build is a repo build: `build list` shows it and `build validate <id>` says ok.
